entries.mission: Diagnose why Governance stops with 'Repository changed unexpectedly' after successful mission execution. Perform a complete root-cause analysis of the runtime pipeline. Do not modify any source code or configuration. Do not create patches. Produce only: (1) root-cause analysis, (2) impacted components, (3) candidate fixes ranked by safety, (4) recommended implementation plan preserving determinism, governance and backward compatibility, (5) rollback strategy, (6) validation plan, (7) final recommendation.
